India lead 1-0 after chasing 226 in the 1st T20I — Samson 67 off 33, Naman Dhir 42* off 15 🔥

Game 2 starts 12:30 PM IST. 2-0 loading? 👀 🏏

India vs New Zealand — 2nd T20I aaj 12:30 PM IST 🏏

👉 Pehle T20I mein India ne 226 ka target chase kiya!

👉 Naman Dhir – 15 balls mein 42* ka finish
👉 NZ ke Glenn Phillips (82*) se bachke rehna hoga

India 1-0 se aage — kya aaj series 2-0 hogi? Comment karo 👇
